acceptance.given: Frozen historical artifact paths are recorded in the repository historical manifest before repair or runtime operations.

oracle.expected: The before/after manifest comparison reports identical repository-relative paths for every frozen historical artifact.
forbidden: Any frozen historical artifact is moved, renamed, relocated, or assigned a different path.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable before/after historical-path manifest comparison executed by the Toolchain validation test.

acceptance.then: The frozen historical artifact path set remains unchanged and any path drift causes validation failure.
acceptance.when: After repair or runtime operations, run the historical artifact path manifest comparison.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the historical-path manifest validator against a fixture that renames or relocates one frozen historical artifact; the validator must reject the changed path set.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain append-only validation that compares frozen historical artifact paths before and after repair/runtime operations and fails on any rename, move, or relocation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing historical manifest schema and append-only evidence semantics; rollback only the path-comparison change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Recorded frozen path set -> repair/runtime operation -> recomputed path set -> unchanged or fail-closed on drift.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The path comparison passes only when every frozen historical artifact retains its original repository-relative path; any drift yields a failing validation result.

acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subject executions are collected for each of the six materially distinct Matrix Cases.

oracle.expected: The execution-evidence validator finds one attributable record for each Matrix Case and subject pairing, with case and subject identities unambiguous.
forbidden: Evidence is missing for a Matrix Case execution.
Evidence cannot be associated unambiguously with its Matrix Case.
Evidence cannot distinguish Stable from Candidate subject execution.
oracle.observable: Machine-readable execution records parsed by the matrix evidence validator, including Matrix Case and subject identifiers.

acceptance.then: Attributable evidence exists for all six Matrix Cases and both subject executions in each case.
acceptance.when: The matrix evidence validator evaluates the collected execution records.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix evidence validator with a record missing a Matrix Case identifier or with Stable/Candidate subject labels colliding; validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure every execution evidence record carries immutable Matrix Case and Stable/Candidate subject identifiers and is rejected when attribution is missing or ambiguous.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing evidence record fields backward compatible; reject only records lacking required attribution.

slice_hint.state_transition: Per-case subject execution -> evidence record with case/subject identity -> validator attribution check -> accepted or failed evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds only when all six distinct Matrix Case IDs each have separately attributable Stable and Candidate records.

acceptance.given: A detached Toolchain Probe is bound to an always-success false-negative case whose process exits successfully while semantic evaluation should fail.

oracle.expected: The evaluator records a failed result classified as an always-success false negative, regardless of the underlying successful process exit.
forbidden: The always-success false-negative case is reported as pass or success.
A successful process exit is treated as sufficient for evaluation success.
oracle.observable: Structured detached Probe output and semantic evaluation verdict for the bound always-success false-negative case.

acceptance.then: The always-success false-negative evaluation is failed.
acceptance.when: The detached real worker executes and evaluates the bound always-success false-negative Probe.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the bound always-success false-negative Probe selector and assert that a pass/success verdict is rejected; the runtime observation must fail if semantic evaluation accepts it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify an always-success process with semantically invalid output as an evaluation failure and preserve the false-negative classification in structured evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve detached Probe input/output contract and existing result schema; rollback only false-negative classification logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Bound Probe input -> independent process execution -> parsed output -> semantic evaluation -> failed false-negative result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evaluation terminates with a failed always-success false-negative result; any pass/success verdict for this case fails the check.

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages are exercised through their Toolchain execution contexts.

oracle.expected: The isolation validator observes independent mutable state for each listed entity; mutating one entity does not alter another entity's state or verification outcome.
forbidden: Mutation in one entity changes another entity's state or verification outcome.
oracle.observable: Machine-readable state identities and pre/post mutation comparisons produced by the Toolchain isolation test.

acceptance.then: Mutable state remains isolated across Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages.
acceptance.when: The isolation test mutates each entity in turn and compares all other entities' state and verification outputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolation validator with two listed entities intentionally referencing the same mutable state object or evidence store; validation must fail when mutation propagates.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce separate mutable state and evidence namespaces for each subject, Probe, Matrix Case, Consumer, and rollback stage, with cross-entity mutation detected and rejected.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain existing serialized evidence fields while isolating mutable stores; no schema reset or data loss.

slice_hint.state_transition: Independent entity contexts -> isolated mutable stores -> mutation probe -> unchanged peers or fail-closed validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The isolation check passes only when each listed entity has a distinct mutable-state identity and peer states/evidence remain unchanged after mutation.
